items.stem: For a bursty MVP API that is often idle, which compute keeps idle cost near zero?

options.text: AWS Lambda, billed per request and duration
options.rationale: Correct: Lambda charges only when invoked, so idle cost is near zero.
Dedicated hosts are costly and overkill for an MVP.
A full cluster is excessive for a bursty MVP.

items.stem: Which TWO are baseline security practices for a startup AWS account? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Avoid using the root account for daily tasks and enable MFA on it
options.rationale: Correct: protecting root and avoiding its daily use is foundational.

options.text: Grant least-privilege IAM roles instead of broad admin
options.rationale: Correct: least privilege limits blast radius.

options.text: Share one IAM user among the whole team
options.rationale: Shared users break accountability and least privilege.
Disabling the audit trail harms security.

items.explanation: Correct: protect root and use least-privilege IAM.
